title: चतुश्चत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 44 · First day: the unrestrained slaughter

summary.en: The fighting loses all restraint, with fathers, sons and kinsmen killing one another, and elephants, horses and men are torn apart. Bhishma, under his silver palm-tree banner, shatters the Pandava ranks.
summary.kn: ಹೋರಾಟ ಎಲ್ಲ ಮಿತಿ ಮೀರುತ್ತದೆ; ತಂದೆ, ಮಕ್ಕಳು, ಬಂಧುಗಳು ಒಬ್ಬರನ್ನೊಬ್ಬರು ಕೊಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಆನೆ ಕುದುರೆ ಮನುಷ್ಯರು ಛಿದ್ರವಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಬೆಳ್ಳಿಯ ತಾಳೆಧ್ವಜದ ಭೀಷ್ಮನು ಪಾಂಡವ ಸಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಒಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युद्ध की सब मर्यादा टूट जाती है; पिता, पुत्र और बन्धु एक-दूसरे को मारते हैं, हाथी-घोड़े और मनुष्य कटते हैं। चाँदी के ताड़ध्वज वाले भीष्म पाण्डव पंक्तियों को तोड़ देते हैं।
summary.te: యుద్ధంలో మర్యాద అంతా తప్పుతుంది; తండ్రులు, కొడుకులు, బంధువులు ఒకరినొకరు చంపుకుంటారు, ఏనుగులు గుర్రాలు మనుషులు ఛిన్నాభిన్నమవుతారు. వెండి తాటిచెట్టు జెండా భీష్ముడు పాండవ శ్రేణులను చీల్చుతాడు.
summary.ta: போரில் எல்லா வரம்பும் மீறப்படுகிறது; தந்தையர், மகன்கள், உறவினர் ஒருவரை ஒருவர் கொல்கின்றனர், யானை குதிரை மனிதர் சிதைகின்றனர். வெள்ளிப் பனைக்கொடி கொண்ட பீஷ்மர் பாண்டவ அணிகளைப் பிளக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: യുദ്ധത്തിന് യാതൊരു നിയന്ത്രണവുമില്ലാതാകുന്നു; അച്ഛനും മകനും ബന്ധുക്കളും പരസ്പരം കൊല്ലുന്നു, ആനകളും കുതിരകളും മനുഷ്യരും ചിന്നിച്ചിതറുന്നു. വെള്ളിപ്പന ചിഹ്നമുള്ള കൊടിക്കീഴിൽ ഭീഷ്മർ പാണ്ഡവ നിരകളെ തകർക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.44; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
राजञ्शतसहस्राणि तत्र तत्र तदा तदा ।
निर्मर्यादं प्रयुद्धानि तत्ते वक्ष्यामि भारत ॥

meaning.en: O king, I shall tell you of the hundreds of thousands who fought here and there, at one time and another, without any restraint, O Bharata.

verses.text:
न पुत्रः पितरं जज्ञे न पिता पुत्रमौरसम् ।
न भ्राता भ्रातरं तत्र स्वस्रीयं न च मातुलः ॥

meaning.en: Son did not know father, nor father his own son; brother did not know brother, nor nephew uncle.

verses.text:
मातुलं न च स्वस्रीयो न सखायं सखा तथा ।
आविष्टा इव युध्यन्ते पाण्डवाः कुरुभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: Nephew did not know maternal uncle, nor friend friend. The Pandavas and Kurus fought as if possessed.

verses.text:
रथानीकं नरव्याघ्राः केचिदभ्यपतन्रथैः ।
अभज्यन्त युगैरेव युगानि भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Some tigers among men fell upon the chariot-ranks with their chariots, and yoke was smashed against yoke, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
रथेषाश्च रथेषाभिः कूबरा रथकूबरैः ।
संहताः संहतैः केचित्परस्परजिघांसवः ॥

meaning.en: Chariot-poles broke on chariot-poles, and axle-frames on axle-frames; some, massed together, were eager to kill each other.

verses.text:
न शेकुश्चलितुं केचित्संनिपत्य रथा रथैः ।
प्रभिन्नास्तु महाकायाः संनिपत्य गजा गजैः ॥

meaning.en: Some chariots, crashing into chariots, could not move, and great rutting elephants, crashing into elephants, did the same.

verses.text:
बहुधादारयन्क्रुद्धा विषाणैरितरेतरम् ।
सतोमरपताकैश्च वारणाः परवारणैः ॥

meaning.en: Angered, they tore one another in many ways with their tusks, the elephants with their spears and banners against the enemy elephants.

verses.text:
अभिसृत्य महाराज वेगवद्भिर्महागजैः ।
दन्तैरभिहतास्तत्र चुक्रुशुः परमातुराः ॥

meaning.en: Great elephants rushed swift upon one another, great king, and those gored by tusks screamed in terrible pain.

verses.text:
अभिनीताश्च शिक्षाभिस्तोत्त्राङ्कुशसमाहताः ।
सुप्रभिन्नाः प्रभिन्नानां संमुखाभिमुखा ययुः ॥

meaning.en: Trained well, struck by goads and prods, the elephants in full rut went face to face against other elephants in rut.

verses.text:
प्रभिन्नैरपि संसक्ताः केचित्तत्र महागजाः ।
क्रौञ्चवन्निनदं मुक्त्वा प्राद्रवन्त ततस्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Some great elephants, locked with rutting ones, gave out cries like cranes and ran off in all directions.

verses.text:
सम्यक्प्रणीता नागाश्च प्रभिन्नकरटामुखाः ।
ऋष्टितोमरनाराचैर्निर्विद्धा वरवारणाः ॥

meaning.en: Fine elephants well trained, with their temples split, pierced by lances, spears and iron arrows,

verses.text:
विनेदुर्भिन्नमर्माणो निपेतुश्च गतासवः ।
प्राद्रवन्त दिशः केचिन्नदन्तो भैरवान्रवान् ॥

meaning.en: bellowed with wounded vitals and fell lifeless; some fled in all directions, uttering terrible cries.

verses.text:
गजानां पादरक्षास्तु व्यूढोरस्काः प्रहारिणः ।
ऋष्टिभिश्च धनुर्भिश्च विमलैश्च परश्वधैः ॥

meaning.en: The foot guards of the elephants, broad-chested strikers, with lances, bows, bright axes,

verses.text:
गदाभिर्मुसलैश्चैव भिण्डिपालैः सतोमरैः ।
आयसैः परिघैश्चैव निस्त्रिंशैर्विमलैः शितैः ॥

meaning.en: maces, clubs, spears, javelins, iron bars and sharp, bright swords,

verses.text:
प्रगृहीतैः सुसंरब्धा धावमानास्ततस्ततः ।
व्यदृश्यन्त महाराज परस्परजिघांसवः ॥

meaning.en: were seen, great king, running here and there in great fury, seeking to kill one another.

verses.text:
राजमानाश्च निस्त्रिंशाः संसिक्ता नरशोणितैः ।
प्रत्यदृश्यन्त शूराणामन्योन्यमभिधावताम् ॥

meaning.en: The shining swords, drenched with human blood, were seen as heroes ran at one another.

verses.text:
अवक्षिप्तावधूतानामसीनां वीरबाहुभिः ।
संजज्ञे तुमुलः शब्दः पततां परमर्मसु ॥

meaning.en: From swords thrown and swung by the arms of heroes and falling on vital places, a tumultuous noise arose.

verses.text:
गदामुसलरुग्णानां भिन्नानां च वरासिभिः ।
दन्तिदन्तावभिन्नानां मृदितानां च दन्तिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Of men crushed by maces and clubs, split by fine swords, torn by elephants' tusks and trampled by elephants,

verses.text:
तत्र तत्र नरौघाणां क्रोशतामितरेतरम् ।
शुश्रुवुर्दारुणा वाचः प्रेतानामिव भारत ॥

meaning.en: here and there the dreadful cries of crowds of men calling to each other were heard, like the cries of ghosts, O Bharata.

verses.text:
हयैरपि हयारोहाश्चामरापीडधारिभिः ।
हंसैरिव महावेगैरन्योन्यमभिदुद्रुवुः ॥

meaning.en: Horsemen on horses with yak-tail plumes rushed at one another, swift as swans.

verses.text:
तैर्विमुक्ता महाप्रासा जाम्बूनदविभूषणाः ।
आशुगा विमलास्तीक्ष्णाः संपेतुर्भुजगोपमाः ॥

meaning.en: Great lances, adorned with gold, were hurled by them, swift, bright, sharp, and fell like snakes.

verses.text:
अश्वैरग्र्यजवैः केचिदाप्लुत्य महतो रथान् ।
शिरांस्याददिरे वीरा रथिनामश्वसादिनः ॥

meaning.en: Some heroes on top-speed horses leaped at great chariots and cut off the heads of the chariot-fighters.

verses.text:
बहूनपि हयारोहान्भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः ।
रथी जघान संप्राप्य बाणगोचरमागतान् ॥

meaning.en: A chariot-warrior killed many horsemen who came within arrow-range, with straight-jointed broad-headed arrows.

verses.text:
नगमेघप्रतीकाशाश्चाक्षिप्य तुरगान्गजाः ।
पादैरेवावमृद्नन्त मत्ताः कनकभूषणाः ॥

meaning.en: Elephants like mountain-clouds, in rut and adorned with gold, pulled horses down and trampled them under foot.

verses.text:
पाट्यमानेषु कुम्भेषु पार्श्वेष्वपि च वारणाः ।
प्रासैर्विनिहताः केचिद्विनेदुः परमातुराः ॥

meaning.en: Elephants were pierced with lances in the temples and sides, and some bellowed in great pain.

verses.text:
साश्वारोहान्हयान्केचिदुन्मथ्य वरवारणाः ।
सहसा चिक्षिपुस्तत्र संकुले भैरवे सति ॥

meaning.en: Some fine elephants, uprooting horses together with their riders, suddenly flung them in that crowded, dreadful scene.

verses.text:
साश्वारोहान्विषाणाग्रैरुत्क्षिप्य तुरगान्द्विपाः ।
रथौघानवमृद्नन्तः सध्वजान्परिचक्रमुः ॥

meaning.en: Elephants lifted horses and riders on their tusks, crushed masses of chariots and ranged about with their banners.

verses.text:
पुंस्त्वादभिमदत्वाच्च केचिदत्र महागजाः ।
साश्वारोहान्हयाञ्जघ्नुः करैः सचरणैस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Some great elephants, from rutting rage and maleness, struck horses and riders with their trunks and feet.

verses.text:
केचिदाक्षिप्य करिणः साश्वानपि रथान्करैः ।
विकर्षन्तो दिशः सर्वाः समीयुः सर्वशब्दगाः ॥

meaning.en: Some elephants, hauling chariots with horses by their trunks, dragged them in every direction, and went all over, roaring.

verses.text:
आशुगा विमलास्तीक्ष्णाः संपेतुर्भुजगोपमाः ।
नराश्वकायान्निर्भिद्य लौहानि कवचानि च ॥

meaning.en: Swift, bright, sharp arrows fell like snakes, piercing the bodies of men and horses and their iron armor.

verses.text:
निपेतुर्विमलाः शक्त्यो वीरबाहुभिरर्पिताः ।
महोल्काप्रतिमा घोरास्तत्र तत्र विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Bright spears hurled by the arms of heroes fell here and there, lord of the people, like great meteors, dreadful.

verses.text:
द्वीपिचर्मावनद्धैश्च व्याघ्रचर्मशयैरपि ।
विकोशैर्विमलैः खड्गैरभिजघ्नुः परान्रणे ॥

meaning.en: They struck down the enemy in battle with bright swords drawn from their scabbards, some of leopard skin and some of tiger skin.

verses.text:
अभिप्लुतमभिक्रुद्धमेकपार्श्वावदारितम् ।
विदर्शयन्तः संपेतुः खड्गचर्मपरश्वधैः ॥

meaning.en: With swords, shields and axes they fell upon those who leaped at them in wrath, one side of whom was split open.

verses.text:
शक्तिभिर्दारिताः केचित्संछिन्नाश्च परश्वधैः ।
हस्तिभिर्मृदिताः केचित्क्षुण्णाश्चान्ये तुरंगमैः ॥

meaning.en: Some were torn by spears and cut by axes, some crushed by elephants and some trampled by horses.

verses.text:
रथनेमिनिकृत्ताश्च निकृत्ता निशितैः शरैः ।
विक्रोशन्ति नरा राजंस्तत्र तत्र स्म बान्धवान् ॥

meaning.en: Men cut by chariot rims and by sharp arrows cried out here and there for their relatives, O king.

verses.text:
पुत्रानन्ये पितॄनन्ये भ्रातॄंश्च सह बान्धवैः ।
मातुलान्भागिनेयांश्च परानपि च संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Some called for sons, others for fathers or brothers and kinsmen, uncles, nephews, and others too, in the battle.

verses.text:
विकीर्णान्त्राः सुबहवो भग्नसक्थाश्च भारत ।
बाहुभिः सुभुजाच्छिन्नैः पार्श्वेषु च विदारिताः ।
क्रन्दन्तः समदृश्यन्त तृषिता जीवितेप्सवः ॥

meaning.en: Many, with their entrails spilling and their thighs broken, their strong arms cut off and their sides torn, were seen crying out, thirsty and wishing to live.

verses.text:
तृष्णापरिगताः केचिदल्पसत्त्वा विशां पते ।
भूमौ निपतिताः संख्ये जलमेव ययाचिरे ॥

meaning.en: Some, weak in spirit and overcome by thirst, lord of the people, fell on the ground in the battle and begged only for water.

verses.text:
रुधिरौघपरिक्लिन्नाः क्लिश्यमानाश्च भारत ।
व्यनिन्दन्भृशमात्मानं तव पुत्रांश्च संगतान् ॥

meaning.en: Drenched in streams of blood and suffering, O Bharata, they bitterly reproached themselves and your sons who had joined the war.

verses.text:
अपरे क्षत्रियाः शूराः कृतवैराः परस्परम् ।
नैव शस्त्रं विमुञ्चन्ति नैव क्रन्दन्ति मारिष ।
तर्जयन्ति च संहृष्टास्तत्र तत्र परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: Other brave warriors, who had enmity with one another, did not let go of their weapons, nor did they cry out, sir; they threatened one another gladly here and there.

verses.text:
निर्दश्य दशनैश्चापि क्रोधात्स्वदशनच्छदान् ।
भ्रुकुटीकुटिलैर्वक्त्रैः प्रेक्षन्ते च परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: Biting their lips in anger, with faces twisted by frowns, they glared at one another.

verses.text:
अपरे क्लिश्यमानास्तु व्रणार्ताः शरपीडिताः ।
निष्कूजाः समपद्यन्त दृढसत्त्वा महाबलाः ॥

meaning.en: Other mighty and steadfast men, though suffering, afflicted by wounds and tormented by arrows, were silent.

verses.text:
अन्ये तु विरथाः शूरा रथमन्यस्य संयुगे ।
प्रार्थयाना निपतिताः संक्षुण्णा वरवारणैः ।
अशोभन्त महाराज पुष्पिता इव किंशुकाः ॥

meaning.en: Other heroes, their chariots lost, fell crushed by fine elephants while seeking another's chariot in battle. They shone, great king, like blossoming kimshuka trees.

verses.text:
संबभूवुरनीकेषु बहवो भैरवस्वनाः ।
वर्तमाने महाभीमे तस्मिन्वीरवरक्षये ॥

meaning.en: Many dreadful sounds arose in the ranks as that terrible destruction of the best heroes went on.

verses.text:
अहनत्तु पिता पुत्रं पुत्रश्च पितरं रणे ।
स्वस्रीयो मातुलं चापि स्वस्रीयं चापि मातुलः ॥

meaning.en: In that battle father killed son and son killed father; nephew killed uncle and uncle nephew.

verses.text:
सखायं च सखा राजन्संबन्धी बान्धवं तथा ।
एवं युयुधिरे तत्र कुरवः पाण्डवैः सह ॥

meaning.en: Friend killed friend, and relative killed kinsman, O king. So the Kurus fought with the Pandavas.

verses.text:
वर्तमाने भये तस्मिन्निर्मर्यादे महाहवे ।
भीष्ममासाद्य पार्थानां वाहिनी समकम्पत ॥

meaning.en: While this terrible, unrestrained, great battle was going on, the army of the sons of Pritha shook as it met Bhishma.

verses.text:
केतुना पञ्चतारेण तालेन भरतर्षभ ।
राजतेन महाबाहुरुच्छ्रितेन महारथे ।
बभौ भीष्मस्तदा राजंश्चन्द्रमा इव मेरुणा ॥

meaning.en: With his silver banner of a palm tree with five stars, raised on his great chariot, mighty-armed Bhishma then shone, O king, like the moon above Mount Meru.
